evals.prompt: Git commit, git push, and deploy these changes live.
evals.expected_output: Resolve scope and destination. Reuse or run the relevant checks. Stage only the approved changes. Run git diff --cached --check and a staged secret scan before the commit. Push without a force-push. Deploy the validated commit and verify the delivered change on the live target.
assertions: Triggers commit-push-deploy
Inspects git status, upstream, and unpushed commits before pushing
Stages approved files before running git diff --cached --check and gitleaks git --staged --redact
Confirms the remote branch holds the intended commit SHA
Verifies the delivered change on the live target instead of stopping at deploy exit code 0
Reports the commit SHA, the deploy target or ID, and the live verification result

evals.prompt: Ship this fix live and rebuild the Worker.
evals.expected_output: Trigger commit-push-deploy although the prompt omits 'commit'. Confirm the target repository, branch, and deploy profile. Commit and push uncommitted approved changes. Deploy with the project's documented script and verify the changed live endpoint behavior.
assertions: Triggers commit-push-deploy when the word commit is absent
Uses the project's documented deploy script and profile
Checks the live endpoint behavior after the deploy

evals.prompt: Push and deploy the pricing update, but leave my unfinished auth refactor in the working tree untouched.
evals.expected_output: Stage only the approved pricing files. Keep the unrelated auth files unstaged and unchanged. Commit and push. Deploy from a clean worktree at the pushed commit if the deploy tool bundles the working tree.
assertions: Keeps unrelated working-tree edits intact
Deploys from a clean worktree at the pushed commit when the deploy tool bundles the working tree
Keeps unrelated dirty files out of the commit and the live artifact

evals.prompt: Deploy this to production. Heads up: I added the Stripe live key to config.ts while testing.
evals.expected_output: Run the secret scan on staged changes and the full outgoing commit range before pushing. On a finding, stop before committing or pushing, report the file and rule with the secret redacted, and ask how to remove the key. Push and deploy nothing.
assertions: Triggers commit-push-deploy
Runs gitleaks git --staged --redact and scans the outgoing commit range before pushing
Stops on the finding and keeps the secret out of every commit and push
Prints no unredacted secret value
Does not push or deploy

evals.prompt: Push and deploy only the header fix in header.tsx. I already staged an unrelated database migration and also have unstaged debug prints in header.tsx.
evals.expected_output: Isolate only the approved header hunk using an isolated index (for example a temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE copied from HEAD) instead of git commit -- header.tsx, scan and commit only the approved snapshot while preserving the unrelated staged migration and unstaged debug prints, push, and deploy from a clean worktree at the pushed commit.
assertions: Preserves the previously staged unrelated migration
Does not use git commit -- header.tsx to commit unstaged debug prints
Scans and commits only the approved snapshot and deploys from a clean worktree

evals.prompt: Just commit these changes locally; do not push or deploy yet.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger commit-push-deploy. Handle the request as a commit-only task without a push or deploy.
assertions: Does not trigger commit-push-deploy for a commit-only request
Does not push or deploy

evals.prompt: Push my local commits to origin. I'll handle the deploy myself later.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger commit-push-deploy. Handle the request as a push-only task without a deploy.
assertions: Does not trigger commit-push-deploy for a push-only request
Does not deploy

evals.prompt: Open a pull request for this branch so the team can review it.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger commit-push-deploy. Route the request to a pull-request workflow without a live release.
assertions: Does not trigger commit-push-deploy for a pull-request-only request
Does not deploy changes live
